SELECT l.id, l.lesson_date AS lessonDate, l.slot_id AS slotId, l.student_id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, s.color AS color, l.status, l.closed, l.absent_by AS absentBy, l.absent_reason AS absentReason, l.make_up_date AS makeUpDate FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id WHERE YEAR(l.lesson_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(l.lesson_date) = #{month} ORDER BY l.lesson_date, l.slot_id

SELECT l.id, l.lesson_date AS `date`, l.slot_id AS slotId, ts.start_time AS slotStart, ts.end_time AS slotEnd, l.status, l.absent_by AS absentBy, l.absent_reason AS reason, l.make_up_date AS makeUpDate FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON l.slot_id = ts.id WHERE l.student_id = #{studentId} AND YEAR(l.lesson_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(l.lesson_date) = #{month} ORDER BY l.lesson_date, ts.start_time, l.slot_id

SELECT s.name AS studentName, l.lesson_date AS `date`, CONCAT(ts.start_time, '-', ts.end_time) AS slot, l.absent_by AS absentBy, l.absent_reason AS reason FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON l.slot_id = ts.id WHERE YEAR(l.lesson_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(l.lesson_date) = #{month} AND l.status IN ('ABSENT', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY l.lesson_date, l.slot_id

SELECT l.id, l.lesson_date AS lessonDate, l.slot_id AS slotId, ts.start_time AS slotStart, ts.end_time AS slotEnd, l.student_id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, c.subject AS subject, l.status, l.closed, l.absent_by AS absentBy, l.absent_reason AS absentReason, l.make_up_date AS makeUpDate FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON l.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON l.slot_id = ts.id WHERE l.lesson_date = #{date} ORDER BY ts.start_time, l.slot_id
